devDependencies.title: Event Ticket Calculator
strengths: Implemented the basic conditional discount calculation without AI
struggles: Handling empty, invalid, and negative numeric input values
Remembering that HTML input values come through as strings
Getting the discount threshold condition exactly right
Prioritizing functionality over CSS within the available time
learned: Calculated values such as subtotal and final total should be derived during render rather than stored in state
Input values should be normalized before being used in calculations
The input to state to normalized value to derived calculation to UI pattern is important for handling user input
reinforce: Handling empty and invalid input values
devDependencies.recurring_weakness: Translating user input into normalized values before using those values in derived calculations
devDependencies.recurring_strength: Understanding and applying the input to state to derived value to UI relationship
